translation:
Traffic Restrictions for the 'KBS Open Concert' Celebrating the University's 80th Anniversary (「개교 80주년 KBS 열린음악회」)
Posted: 2026-10-08

To ensure the safe running of the 'KBS Open Concert' celebrating the university's 80th anniversary, traffic on campus will be restricted as shown below. Please take note.

1. Restricted area: Main Sports Ground side-path car park (대운동장 사잇길 주차장)
Period: 8 October (Thu) 21:00 to 14 October (Wed) 23:59
Notes: No parking and no passage.

2. Restricted area: Main Gate streamside temporary car park (정문 천변 임시주차장)
Period: 8 October (Thu) 21:00 to 14 October (Wed) 23:59
Notes: No parking.

3. Restricted area: From Main Gate Pay Station B to the three-way junction in front of the Business School, near G9 (정문 B정산소 ~ 경영대앞삼거리(G9 인근))
Period: 11 October (Sun) 21:00 to 13 October (Tue) 23:59
Notes: No parking.
Period: 13 October (Tue) 21:30 to 22:30
Notes: No passage for general vehicles. Route buses will operate normally.

※ For the detailed restricted areas, see the attachment.

Attachment: Detailed map of restricted areas, 1 copy. End.

Attached file (1): (붙임) 교통 통제 상세 안내도.pdf (143 KB). The content of this attachment was not read and is not included in this translation.
